result.instructions: Tools for FeedLetter, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my FeedLetter surveys whose name contains 'Issue'."; "Create a three-answer newsletter survey for issue #43 with the external id newsletter-43."; "Show the votes and feedback for my latest poll.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FeedLetter data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run feedletter_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run feedletter_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run feedletter_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. feedletter_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: feedletter_list_surveys
tools.title: List surveys
tools.description: List or search your FeedLetter surveys (newsletter surveys, one-time polls and web rating widgets), newest first, 50 per page. q matches the name, id or external_id. Each item has id, type, name, external_id, public_title and created_at. While has_more is true, call again with page + 1. Read-only. FeedLetter API: GET /v2/surveys.

q.description: Search text: matches name, id or external_id. Omit to list all surveys.

page.description: Page number, from 1. Each page holds 50 surveys.

tools.name: feedletter_get_survey
tools.title: Get a survey
tools.description: Get one survey by its FeedLetter survey id: settings, placement code (links or embed_html), analytics (votes, daily votes, sentiment) and all feedback. Set results_only to true for just the identity, analytics and feedback. Use the survey id, not the external_id. Read-only. FeedLetter API: GET /v2/surveys/{id}.

survey_id.description: The survey id returned by feedletter_list_surveys or feedletter_create_survey.

results_only.description: true returns only identity, analytics and feedback (no settings or placement code).

tools.name: feedletter_get_wall_of_love
tools.title: Get a Wall of Love
tools.description: Get the feedback that one Wall of Love shows, to build your own wall. Each item has id, comment, name (when shown), answer_label, created_at and survey_title. Comment and name are HTML-escaped. Business plan only: other plans get 403 plan_required. Read-only. FeedLetter API: GET /v2/walls-of-love/{id}.

wall_id.description: The Wall of Love id, from its /walloflove/{id} address or embed code.

tools.name: feedletter_create_survey
tools.title: Create a survey
tools.description: Create a newsletter survey, a one-time poll or a web rating widget. Needs a Read & write key. Only type and name are required. Newsletter and poll responses return links (one voting link per answer) and email_html; web ratings return embed_html. Set external_id to your own stable id: a second call with the same external_id returns the existing survey (HTTP 200, already_exists) and changes nothing. Without external_id, each call creates a new survey. Do not combine copy_from with text_template. FeedLetter API: POST /v2/surveys.

public_title.description: Title on public pages such as the Wall of Love. Defaults to name.

external_id.description: Your stable id for this survey, unique across the account. Reuse it when retrying the same creation.

text_template.description: Texts style. newsletter_defaults is for newsletters only.

copy_from.description: Survey id of a survey of the same type to copy answers and settings from.

satisfaction_survey.description: Poll only: enable sentiment and email statistics.

voting.description: Voting block for newsletter and poll surveys. Omit to keep the base answers.

question.description: Question shown above the answers (newsletter and poll).

introduction.description: Text shown above the answer links.

answers.description: Newsletter: exactly 3, ordered positive, neutral, negative. Poll: 1 to 5 answers (4 and 5 need Pro).

rating.description: Rating block for web_rating surveys only.

question.description: Question shown on the web rating widget.

rating_type.description: Answer style for a web rating. Default thumbs.

headlines_after_voting.description: One headline per answer, in answer order. Must match the answer count when answers are set.

comment_prompts.description: Web rating only: exactly 3 prompts for thumbs, 5 for stars or emojis, best to worst.

name_placeholder.description: Name placeholder. Empty hides the name field.

email_placeholder.description: Email placeholder. Empty hides the email field.

thank_you_page.description: Thank-you page shown after a vote.

show_result.description: Show the voting results after a vote (links surveys).

x_username.description: X username for the share button.

redirect_url.description: Redirect after voting (Pro). Empty means no redirect.

advanced.description: Advanced settings. Each field inherits its base value when omitted.

enable_extended_feedback_page.description: Show the extended feedback page after voting (Pro).

prefill_email.description: Prefill the email from the voting link's e parameter (Pro).

require_email.description: Require an email on a web rating (Pro).

show_widget_after_seconds.description: Web rating: delay before the widget shows, in seconds (Pro).

enable_review_schema.description: Web rating: enable review structured data (Pro).

email_on_new_feedback.description: Email address that receives a notice for each new feedback (Pro). Empty disables it.
